authentication: WIPO account for the registered Web Services (SOAP/XML); subscription for PCT data products
cost_notes: Search UI free; registered Web Services and PCT data products are account/subscription based; prices not public.
free_tier: free web search UI; Web Services and PCT data products are registration/subscription based
historical_coverage: PCT applications from 1978; national collections vary
known_limitations: PROBED 2026-11-09: no open machine interface exists. The search UI is a JSF application (server-side session state, j_idt view ids); an undocumented /search/api/ path returned 404.
The data-products page links a subscription route ('subscribe-pct-data-products-services') - PCT data is licensed, not open.
WIPO does publish registered Web Services (SOAP/XML) and a fee-based bulk data service; neither could be verified without an account, so 'PARTIAL' is a documentation claim, not an observation.
Scraping the search UI is both brittle and outside the collection policy; it was not attempted beyond one liveness check.
licence: WIPO terms of use; bulk data products licensed separately
rate_limits: UNKNOWN - not observable without an account
research_value: The only practical way to see a device technology's PCT filing 18 months after priority - i.e. BEFORE most national grants and often before any national publication in smaller jurisdictions. For a genuine early public-visibility clock this matters, but it is registration-gated, so it cannot be claimed as available in this round.
timestamp_fields: WO publication date = the 18-month public disclosure -> source_public_at
